parsed.summary: Your phone was stolen on the Tunis metro. Act quickly to secure your data, block the SIM, report the theft to the police and your carrier, and file a loss report on Lqitha.

steps.action: Call your own number from another phone to see if someone answers and can keep it safe.
Use Find My iPhone or Find My Device (Google) to locate, lock, or erase the phone remotely.
Change passwords for email, social media, banking and any other critical accounts that were accessible from the phone.
Contact your mobile operator (Tunisie Telecom, Ooredoo, or Orange Tunisie) to suspend the SIM and request a replacement SIM with the same number, presenting your ID at an agency.
File a police report at the nearest police station or the national guard (emergency 197 or 193). Provide the phone’s IMEI number (dial *#06# or find on box/facture).
Report the theft on the Lqitha platform, including detailed description of the phone (color, brand, case, wallpaper, any distinctive marks) to increase chances of recovery.

steps.when: When you reach the metro station or line office
steps.action: Inform the metro staff or the station manager of the loss, giving the line number, direction, approximate time, and any details of the incident.
